decision: At matched approximately 124M trainable-parameter scale and 51.2M fresh trace presentations, compare a token LM, a CE-only sentence LM, the selected two-step pooled sentence JEPA, and the identical JEPA without a token prior. All models use an effective batch of 512, 100,000 optimizer updates, original-iGSM optimizer hyperparameters, and exposure-qualified checkpoints. This first scheduler segment is resumable and must never restart from scratch after a walltime boundary.

jobs.purpose: Train the 123.32M pooled sentence JEPA with its learned token prior toward 51.2M fresh traces; preserve frequent resumable and scientific milestone checkpoints.
Train the matched pooled sentence JEPA with the token-prior module and loss removed, isolating whether prior supervision changes representation learning and downstream planning.
Train the 123.93M decoder-only token LM on the same fresh trace stream, optimizer-update count, effective batch, and checkpoint schedule.
Train the 123.21M CE-only sentence-latent LM with the same fresh trace stream, optimizer-update count, effective batch, and checkpoint schedule.
